visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a close-up of a green parking meter situated in a dimly lit outdoor environment at night. The device features a black panel with a glowing red circular button and a digital display screen showing the text "課金中". The surrounding background is out of focus, indicating a narrow urban alley or sidewalk with low-level artificial lighting and dark vertical structures. (2) The camera pans upwards to reveal a large, rectangular white signboard with red borders listing various parking rates in Japanese yen. The sign is brightly illuminated by an LED strip along its top edge, creating a high-contrast visual. A man's hand wearing a black watch enters from the right side of the frame, pointing at the numbers to emphasize the costs. The background shows a dark building wall and a night sky silhouette.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 一小時台幣400的奢侈停車場. [Variety]: 課金中. [Subtitle]: 哇 這個日本停車位. (2) [Subtitle]: 是真的顯示課金中. (3) [Subtitle]: 然後呢 我停在. (4) [Subtitle]: 港區的麻布十番. (5) [Subtitle]: 就是最精華的地段. (6) [Subtitle]: 各位10分鐘500元是什麼意思. (7) [Subtitle]: 就是10分鐘100塊台幣. (8) [Subtitle]: 你有看過這麼貴的嗎. (9) [Subtitle]: 而且這個還是比較佛系的. (10) [Subtitle]: 他說最大就2000円. (11) [Subtitle]: 等於是你停40分鐘之後就這樣. (12) [Subtitle]: 他沒有無上限. (13) [Subtitle]: 有一些是無上限. (14) [Subtitle]: 聽說停一晚會上萬日幣. (15) [Variety]: (嚇死人).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice with high vocal arousal and an energetic, friendly tone begins narrating immediately in Mandarin. The speech rate is fast and enthusiastic, focusing on the novelty of the Japanese parking meter's display. A high-tempo electronic background music track with a strong, repetitive synthesizer beat and a clear major-mode tonality plays consistently in the background, maintaining a constant volume level without any audible environmental noise or interference. (2) As the narration continues, the speaker's pitch variability increases to express surprise at the high prices of 500 yen per 10 minutes. The electronic BGM persists, featuring a crisp percussive rhythm that matches the fast verbal delivery. The audio mix is clean, with the voice clearly centered and the music sitting comfortably below it. There are no sudden SFX or background noises, resulting in a very high signal-to-noise ratio and a professional, post-produced audio quality.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to shock and inform viewers about the extreme cost of living/parking in elite districts of Tokyo. By showing a literal 'micro-transaction' parking meter and a price board, the narrator uses relatable currency conversion to highlight the luxury pricing of 400 NTD per hour.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses gaming terminology ('micro-transaction/課金') to frame a mundane urban experience, effectively engaging a younger audience.
